text_simplified: This text discusses the importance of accustoming children to fasting and 'ibadat (acts of worship) from a young age, mentioning stories from Islamic heritage about encouraging children to fast. It explains that accustoming a child to fasting and 'ibadat helps them adhere to them in the future. It also notes that fasting is not obligatory for young children, but it is beneficial for their tarbiyah (upbringing).

review_defects.why: The transliteration of عبادات is inconsistent within the document: the title uses 'Ibadat (capital I, apostrophe before I) while the body text uses 'ibadat (lowercase i). This inconsistency in transliteration of the same Islamic term should be avoided.
